server.name: Talent OS AI

tools.description: Generate an AI project health summary with highlights, blockers, and next actions.

tools.title: AI Shortlist Summary
tools.description: Compare shortlisted candidates and recommend the best fit.

tools.name: ai_status_assessment
tools.title: AI Status Assessment
tools.description: Assess project delivery risk and suggest status transitions.

tools.name: ai_get_request_status
tools.title: Get AI Request Status
tools.description: Poll the status and result of an async AI request.

tools.name: ai_list_prompts

tools.description: List registered prompt templates and versions from the AI Gateway Prompt Manager.
